## The freeze's honest outcome — `task_lists.state: "blocked"`

The committed W1 register records all 20 re-proofed tasks discordant
`o_fail` — the O surface failed on every trial with a recorded Harbor
exception (a machinery failure: the pinned podman-compose does not
recognize Harbor's `--in-pod=false` flag). This is machinery failure
evidence, **not agreement data** — the packet says so verbatim and the
freeze applies the contract's typed rules to the register as committed:

- 14 slots record `blocked{un_reproofed_successor}` naming their next
  order member (`needs: wc_reproof`) — an un-re-proofed member is never
  silently admitted.
- 2 dev slots carry `disclosure: req_xh_127_c_adjacent_cell`.
- 3 dev-medium slots record `blocked{no_adjacent_donor}` — REQ-XH-127(c)
  maps easy|hard → medium only; the emptied medium cell refuses typed.

No list was frozen over un-verified tasks, no exclusion was hidden,
and no machinery discordance was converted into an admit. Resolution
is Wc's repair re-proof under the same committed rules.
